title: Distributed Lock
description: Build a distributed lock implementation with fencing tokens, lease expiry, heartbeat renewal, and deadlock prevention.

steps.title: Create lock data structure
steps.description: Define a `Lock` data structure with fields: `resourceId` (string), `owner` (string), `token` (number), `expiry` (number, epoch ms), `acquiredAt` (number, epoch ms). Create a helper function `createLock(resourceId, owner, token, ttlMs)` that returns a new lock object. Print the lock info for resource 'file-1' owned by 'node-1' with token 1 and 30s TTL.
hints: The lock object represents an exclusive hold on a resource by a single owner
expiry should be calculated as Date.now() + ttlMs
Print each field of the lock on a separate line

verification.successMessage: Lock data structure contains all required fields and is correctly initialized!
verification.failureMessage: Print each field of the lock: resourceId, owner, token, expiry, and acquiredAt.

steps.title: Implement acquire with fencing token
steps.description: Build an `acquire(resourceId, owner, ttlMs)` function that returns a lock with a monotonically increasing fencing token. Maintain a global token counter that increments on each acquire. If the resource is already locked and not expired, return null. Print the fencing token assigned with each successful acquire attempt.
hints: Store active locks in a Map keyed by resourceId
Check if existing lock exists and is not expired before acquiring
Increment a global counter for each successful acquire to use as the fencing token

verification.successMessage: Fencing tokens are monotonically increasing and sequential!
verification.failureMessage: Print 'Acquired with token N' on each successful acquire to show the token assigned.

steps.title: Add lease with TTL
steps.description: Implement lease expiry so that a lock auto-releases when its TTL expires. Add an `isExpired(lock)` helper and modify `acquire()` to check for expired locks before returning null. Test by acquiring a lock with a short TTL (50ms), waiting for it to expire, then acquiring again. Print lease state showing acquired, expired, and re-acquired status.
hints: A lock is expired when Date.now() >= lock.expiry
When acquiring, if an expired lock exists, treat the resource as free
Print timestamps to show when locks are acquired and when they expire

verification.successMessage: Lease expiry correctly auto-releases locks after the TTL elapses!
verification.failureMessage: Print the lease state showing when a lock is acquired, when it expires, and when it is re-acquired.

steps.title: Implement heartbeat renewal
steps.description: Add an `extendLock(resourceId, owner, newTtlMs)` function that refreshes the expiry on an active lock. Only the current owner can extend the lock. If the lock is held by a different owner or already expired, return false. Test by acquiring a lock, extending it twice, and printing the renewal count and updated expiry.
hints: Verify the owner matches the lock's owner field before extending
Track renewalCount on the lock to show how many times it was extended

verification.successMessage: Heartbeat renewal correctly extends the lock lease for the owning node only!
verification.failureMessage: Print 'Renewal #N: expiry now <timestamp>' for each successful extension.

steps.title: Add deadlock detection
steps.description: Implement timeout-based deadlock detection. Create a `Detector` that periodically scans active locks and flags any held beyond `maxLockDurationMs`. Add a `forceRelease(resourceId)` method that logs and breaks the deadlock. Simulate a deadlock by acquiring two locks in different orders and print the deadlock detection and resolution.
hints: Track lockAcquiredAt timestamp and compare to maxLockDurationMs on each scan
forceRelease() should remove the lock from the active locks map and log the forced release
Print 'Deadlock detected on resource: <id>' and 'Force released: <id>' during simulation

verification.successMessage: Deadlock detection correctly identifies and forcefully releases stuck locks!
verification.failureMessage: Print 'Deadlock detected on resource: <id>' and 'Force released <resource>'.

steps.title: Build a lock manager
steps.description: Create a `LockManager` class that manages multiple resources with a request queue. Implement `requestLock(resourceId, owner, ttlMs)` that queues the request if the resource is locked, and `releaseLock(lock)` that removes and processes the next queued request. Print the manager state showing the queue and active locks after each operation.
hints: Maintain a queue per resource: pendingRequests[resourceId] = [{ owner, ttlMs, resolve }]
On release, dequeue the next waiter and grant them the lock
Print a summary of active locks and queued waiters after each operation

verification.successMessage: Lock Manager correctly queues requests, grants locks in order, and releases cleanly!
verification.failureMessage: Print the full manager state showing active locks and pending queue after each operation.
